title: Run 25: deeper + wider encyclopedia experiment
predecessor: run_024 (48 concepts, NICHE_NOT_FOUND; only 12 sparsest deep grounded-gap verified)
purpose: CONTINUE — do not stop at Run 24's zero. Actively hunt whether Run 24 MISSED a gap by (a) only deep-verifying the 12 sparsest, (b) not mining the C41 residual, (c) small sample. R12/R14.

parts.PART_A: Deep grounded-gap verify the 33 Run-24 concepts that were prima-facie no-collision but NOT in the sparsest-12. Question: did sparsest-selection miss a real gap in a less-sparse concept? A concept with more raw hits could still have an unoccupied functional fusion.
parts.PART_B: Source 5 NEW transition/transformation/metamorphosis-family concepts + deep-verify; assess whether C41 (liminality, novelty 0.34) is isolated-trivial or the edge of a sparse cluster.
parts.PART_C: Source 50 NEW concepts (not in Run 24's 48, not in candidate_pool, not PART B), stratified obscure-biased; full pipeline incl grounded-gap verify of sparsest. Running total 48+50=98.

method: Same as Run 24: mechanism atoms (verbatim >=30c) -> per-atom ML-penetration (NONE/MEASURES/IMPORTED) -> candidate -> grounded-gap functional verify (5 reformulations, mechanical anti-narrowing rule >=2 content words = forced hit) -> 4 gates (composite>=0.90, quarantine, >=5-source no-collision, Belinda-strict).

hard_rules.R5: Record ONLY real search results; NEVER fabricate.
hard_rules.R8: No hook in container; gates applied manually.
hard_rules.R12: Do NOT stop at the prior result; the 33 unverified concepts are the real opportunity to find an overlooked gap.
hard_rules.R13: Honest feasibility; do not pre-dismiss C41-family.
hard_rules.R14: If a concept clears gates, do NOT explain it away; verify hard, but if it survives grounded-gap + cross-check + audit, report it LOUDLY as a real lead.

result.PART_A: 33 deep-verified -> 31 COLLISION + 2 candidate gaps (C30 flipped to honeypot, C37 survived sub-gate)
result.PART_B: C41 = cluster but occupied niche, no lead
result.PART_C: 50 new; 9/9 sonnet gap-flags, 8 collapsed under cross-check, C57 survived sub-gate
result.headline: 0/98 clear all gates; 9/11 candidate gaps were Pattern-D false positives; 2 sub-gate over-specification residuals (C37 0.42, C57 0.45). Strongest empirical saturation evidence yet with honest non-zero literal-gap tail.
